liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (2 reviews, 1 other source): Recommends the Dark Star into Comes a Time sequence as a highlight; Calls the Dark Star beautiful [4][5][12]
- **Greatest Story Ever Told//** (1 review): This copy has the full Greatest Story, which cuts out mid-jam on the other version [14]

## Setlist highlights

- **One More Saturday**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [17]

## The recordings

- **gd72-07-26.sbd.popi.8957.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 30 songs; 229 min; rated 4.56/5 by 18 [1]
- **gd72-07-26.sbd.clugston.1411.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 29 songs; 230 min; rated 4.31/5 by 13 [2]. Said about its sound: Soundboard sound is clean and good; Vocals sit too far forward in the mix, burying the instruments during harmonies; Tape speed runs slightly slow, which makes Jerry sound a bit off [5][9][12][14][16]
- **gd1972-07-26.sbd-patched.long.34803.flac16**: soundboard; 28 songs; 230 min; rated 2.67/5 by 3 [4]. Said about its sound: Several sub-second dropouts around 12:38 in Dark Star were repaired [4]
- **gd1972-07-26.sbd.GEMS.87034.flac16**: soundboard; 28 songs; 231 min; rated 4.57/5 by 7 [3]

## Around the show

- This was the second of two Paramount Theater shows in Portland, Oregon [19]
- Setlist is fairly standard for the period, though solid [5]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd72-07-26.sbd.popi.8957.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Seth Kaplan and Popi; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: He's Gone was missing from the original checksum file and patched from an unknown source, probably re-extracted Clugston seed [1]
- **gd72-07-26.sbd.clugston.1411.sbeok.shnf**: source: Master Soundboard Reel [2]. Also: Chain: master soundboard reel to PCM, DAT, ZA2, then two CDR generations; DAT seed via Jeff Tiedrich [2]
- **gd1972-07-26.sbd-patched.long.34803.flac16**: transferred by Andrew Long; source: MR > PCM > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN [4]. Also: Greatest Story was patched from an alternate soundboard source, brightened with iZotope Ozone to match the primary [4]
- **gd1972-07-26.sbd.GEMS.87034.flac16**: taped by DAT from Todd Evans; transferred by Jamie Waddell; source: MR -> DAT (the DAT is 16-bit; 44.1kHz which could indicate MR->PCM->DAT) [3]

claims.text: Soundboard sound is clean and good
Recommends the Dark Star into Comes a Time sequence as a highlight
Setlist is fairly standard for the period, though solid
Vocals sit too far forward in the mix, burying the instruments during harmonies
Tape speed runs slightly slow, which makes Jerry sound a bit off
Finds the speed fine, and the sound as good as the alternate source
This copy has the full Greatest Story, which cuts out mid-jam on the other version
Very good sound quality; forward vocals considered normal for the era's recordings
He's Gone was missing from the original checksum file and patched from an unknown source, probably re-extracted Clugston seed
Chain: master soundboard reel to PCM, DAT, ZA2, then two CDR generations; DAT seed via Jeff Tiedrich
Greatest Story was patched from an alternate soundboard source, brightened with iZotope Ozone to match the primary
Several sub-second dropouts around 12:38 in Dark Star were repaired
Dark Star is kept as one track; an earlier seed's Drums track was actually brief drums, Phil, then an extended jam
